name: Cetuximab plus Platinum and Infusional Fluorouracil (EXTREME), First-Line Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma, then Cetuximab Maintenance

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.PD_L1: not required (chemotherapy plus cetuximab backbone; used regardless of PD-L1, including PD-L1 negative disease)
biomarkers.note: Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers v2.2026, SYST-A 4 of 7, the platinum plus infusional fluorouracil plus cetuximab (EXTREME) regimen is an Other Recommended first- and subsequent-line combination (category 1) and is not PD-L1 gated. The Discussion (MS-56) and Harrison 22nd ed. note that patients with no PD-L1 expression may still be treated with the prior EXTREME chemotherapy standard.

premedications.name: Cetuximab premedication
premedications.notes: antihistamine (and per institutional practice a corticosteroid) before the cetuximab loading dose per cetuximab labeling; infusion-reaction precautions.

supportiveCare: Antiemetic prophylaxis for the cisplatin-containing cycles: high emetic risk (cisplatin); prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Monitor for cetuximab infusion reactions and acneiform rash; hypomagnesemia surveillance (cetuximab plus cisplatin).
Fluoropyrimidine safety: consider DPYD genotyping before fluorouracil; reduce or avoid in DPYD deficiency.
G-CSF / febrile-neutropenia risk assessment per institutional practice (VERIFY: not established in the cited sources for this regimen).
monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cisplatin dose
serum magnesium and electrolytes (cisplatin and cetuximab)
Mucositis and diarrhea assessment - infusional fluorouracil
imaging every 2 to 3 cycles in the recurrent/metastatic setting (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, SYST-A 1 of 7 general principles)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher cetuximab infusion reaction or severe acneiform rash
doseModificationRules.text: Manage per cetuximab labeling; hold or reduce and obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

doseModificationRules.condition: renal impairment or cytopenia on day 1
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: CISplatin 100 mg/m2 IV on day 1 every 21 days. The 100 mg/m2 every 3 weeks cisplatin value is sourced to DeVita 12th ed. (line 58325), the recurrent or metastatic Wayne State cisplatin plus 5-fluorouracil regimen, which matches the platinum dose used in the recurrent/metastatic EXTREME regimen. The recurrent/metastatic setting is per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026 SYST-A 4 of 7. Source-stated platinum alternative for cisplatin-ineligible patients: CARBOplatin dosed by target AUC (AUC value not established in the cited sources; requires verification). ISMP tall-man applied.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 58325 (recurrent or metastatic Wayne State regimen: cisplatin 100 mg/m2 IV recycled every 3 weeks)

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (infusional)
drugs.notes: Infusional fluorouracil 1,000 mg/m2 per day by continuous IV infusion over 96 hours (days 1 to 4), recycled every 3 weeks, is grounded to DeVita 12th ed. line 58326 to 58327 (the recurrent or metastatic Wayne State cisplatin plus 5-fluorouracil regimen), which is the platinum/fluorouracil backbone of EXTREME. DPYD deficiency substantially increases fluoropyrimidine toxicity; consider DPYD testing before treatment.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

drugs.name: Cetuximab
drugs.notes: Cetuximab 400 mg/m2 IV loading over 2 hr in week 1, then 250 mg/m2 IV over 1 hr weekly (days 1, 8, 15 of each 21-day cycle). The 250 mg/m2 recurrent or metastatic head and neck dose is anchored to DeVita 12th ed. line 58216 (Table 23.9, Cetuximab for Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Cancer); the 400 mg/m2 loading then 250 mg/m2 weekly administration schedule is the standard cetuximab schedule (DeVita 12th ed. line 124823 to 124824). dosePerUnit records the recurring weekly 250 mg/m2 dose; the 400 mg/m2 week-1 loading dose is recorded in this note. Cetuximab continues as maintenance monotherapy after the platinum/fluorouracil phase ends.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: recurrent or metastatic head and neck in-indication anchor line 58216 (Table 23.9, Cetuximab for Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Cancer, 250 mg per m2); standard administration schedule line 124823 to 124824 (400 mg/m2 loading dose week 1 over 2 hr, then weekly 250 mg/m2 over 1 hr)
